values.quantity: cell count range on the balance lead
values.value: 1 to 16 cells, for the 16-cell pack of F15
values.source: F15 (owner, 2026-09-25): 16 cells, 67.2 V at 4.2 V a cell
values.refutation_tried: F15's answer only gives the top of the range (16 cells); the lower bound of 1 is SET_PACK_CELLS's physical floor (shared/settings/settings.c:39-41) and is already a question under Raised by P1 (V181), so it is not re-raised here

values.value: 1 to 14 cells, which changes with SET_PACK_CELLS
values.refutation_tried: the three cited files describe a 1-to-14 setting range and a cell-count field in the battery screen's state; the cell monitor itself must still cover 1 to 16, above this, matching Research.md's R9 row

values.quantity: balance-lead input separation from the 2S pack's lead
values.value: a separate input, because both packs are connected during a motor test
values.source: IOBoard.md:402, Bench pack balance lead: 'It has its own input, separate from the ESC pack's balance-lead input of the 1 to 16 cell monitor (R9): both packs are connected during a motor test'
values.refutation_tried: matches IOBoard.md:402 word for word; the reason given there (both packs connected during a motor test) is stated, not inferred
matches V189's answer text exactly ('rated 85 V DC working or more ... no offset limit below that'); this is the owner's stated decision, not a P1-derived or assumed figure

values.value: an isoSPI transceiver pair or a digital isolator
values.refutation_tried: matches V189's answer wording; both technologies are explicitly left open by the owner, so this is not a P1 assumption narrowing it to one

values.value: 4 signals: SPI1_RX / MISO (device to host), SPI1_SCLK (host to device), SPI1_TX / MOSI (host to device), GPIO 15 / cell monitor CS (host to device)
values.source: Pins.md measurement-coprocessor pin table, rows for GPIO 8, 10, 11 and 15
values.refutation_tried: each row states its signal 'reaches the cell monitor only across the barrier' (GPIO 8, 10, 11) or is 'to the host side of the ... barrier' (GPIO 15); the direction follows from each signal's own name (RX/TX/SCLK/CS), not assumed by P1

values.quantity: SPI clock and mode the barrier must pass
values.value: ADBMS1818 in SPI mode 3 at 1 MHz at most
values.source: Pins.md, 'Rules the map follows': 'the ADBMS1818 in mode 3 at 1 MHz at most'
values.refutation_tried: stated as a flat design rule for the shared measurement SPI1 bus, distinguishing the ADS1235's and MAX31856's modes from the ADBMS1818's; not computed or inferred by P1

values.source: selection.json (R9, Cell monitor, rank 1, round 1 run FU-C1); IOBoard.md:473 state column
values.refutation_tried: selection.json counts over any re-rank and round 2's Follow-ups table (Research.md:585) names only 'cell monitor isolation barrier (new)' for R9, not 'Cell monitor' itself, so this part and function are unchanged and not re-opened by this task

questions.question: What voltage, in V, and current, in mA, does the cell monitor isolation barrier's device-side logic need, referenced to the ESC pack's negative, and what on the IO board supplies it?
questions.why: P2 cannot shortlist an isoSPI transceiver pair or a digital isolator without knowing the supply voltage and current its device-side (pack-referenced) half must run from; IOBoard.md:474 and Pins.md state that GPIO 15 and the SPI1 lines drive only the barrier's host side, and name no device-side supply, voltage or source
